name: Geth's fortress
description: A colossal black bone and red sinew fortress in the Dross Pits with an imitation throne.

description_citations.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
description_citations.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel walks through Geth's holding, noting the many aspirants and incompleat creatures, and reaches his fortress and empty throne.
timeline.quote: you do see more aspirants than you have in a long time.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Geth ambushes Ixhel, whom he mocks as a foot soldier, and speaks of loyalty that can be bought.
timeline.quote: The only true loyalty is that which can be bought.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Geth asks what Ixhel will have beyond her orthodoxy and the love of her mother, and chokes her.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel opens her own throat on Geth's blade to break free and beheads him.
timeline.quote: you bring down your blade in a single stroke, parting his head from his body.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.
